# E11 — Docs and ADR hygiene: implementation-ready spec (basis: `origin/main` = `083620b08116`)

## Decisions fixed by this research (deviations from the brief flagged with ⚠)

| Item | Decision | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Consolidated ADR number | **0119** (`docs/adr/0119-reconciler-architecture-consolidated-record.md`) | 116 ADRs / 116 markers on origin/main (highest `0116`); CLI epic claims 0117, MCP epic 0118. Slug classifies to "Reconciler & Jira sync" (`scripts/gen_adr_index.py:33-88`, verified with `_classify`). |
| `docs/code-review-fp-ledger.md` | ⚠ **KEEP** (not a dated evidence record) | Undated process contract: documents the `fp:code-review` tag, required body fields and the `root-cause:` enum that `src/rebar/llm/code_review/fp_ledger.py:5` names as its documentation. No ticket cites it; deleting it orphans the ledger contract. |
| ADR 0029 banner | ⚠ **Not superseded** by 0092/0094/0103/0107 — banner is "context landed; decisions stand" | `0103-…md:69-72` and `0107-…md:292-295` both state 0029's arbitration is consumed **unchanged**; 0092/0094 never cite it. | Phantom `docs/designs/sync-hardening-proposal.md` | Never existed in git history (`git log --all -- 'docs/designs/*'` empty). Replacement: **Item 3** → `_field_contract.py` (exists) + story `a130-2b7c-429c-43d1`; **Item 4b** → ADR 0028 + bug `13eb-c414-0763-4fa1` (false-topaz-prong). In `check_comment_hygiene.py`/its test the path is only a *fixture* of a hyphen-triple filename → replace with the real `docs/plan-review-gate.md`. | `scripts/check_comment_hygiene.py:90`, `tests/unit/test_comment_hygiene_guard.py:166-178` |
| Evidence-record targets | `remediation-implementation-plan.md` + `oss-comparison-and-remediation.md` → epic **hoary-datum-cop** `0b32-bc94-5ea1-482a` (P1.0, root of the `oss-remediation` set; `docs/archive/2026-06-13-oss-comparison-session-log.md:84-92`); `88ab-feature-branch-evidence.md` → epic **elfish-chair-lug** `88ab-7052-8850-46d4`; `dco-rollout-evidence.md` → story **sepia-cardiac-hawk** `ddcd-fc9e-a81f-4cbb` (named in the doc); `serena-symbol-reference-coaching-sample.md` → story **surprised-overjoyful-earthworm** `84c7-ad6c-be99-4c30` (named in the doc). All closed; `rebar comment` has no status check (`src/rebar/_commands/leaf.py:49-75`); none is bridge-bound; all five pass the write-time secret screen (0 findings); largest existing comment is 127 KB so the 52 KB plan fits. |
| Owned elsewhere (say so) | ADR 0071 → editor epic; 0086 (incl. `docs/adr/0086…:67`) → overlap epic; 0044/0049 → HMAC epic; `docs/config.md` tombstone list → config epic; `docs/experiments/`, `docs/calibration/`, `docs/README.md:130,142` → eval-harness epic; `inbound_differ.py:266` + `apply_handlers.py:505` → reconciler epic (exact edits in §Cross-epic). 0042/0090 already carry the banner (`0042…md:3`, `0090…md:5`). | |

Banner format to mirror (quote, `docs/adr/0042-auto-lander.md:3`):
`> **Superseded by [ADR 0047](0047-retire-autolander-rebase-if-necessary.md) (2026-07-13).** Kept for historical context; the decision below no longer reflects how changes land.`
Placement: after the `# ADR` title (and after any existing `> **Renumbered/Number note**` blockquote), before the `**Status:**` line.

---

## Context / Problem
`docs/` carries five dated evidence and analysis files (1,430 lines) that are the durable copy of closed ticket trails, two 13-line "moved" stubs kept only for links that exist solely in `docs/README.md`, and six citations of a design document (`docs/designs/sync-hardening-proposal.md`) that never existed in git history. Six ADRs carry stale or unmarked status (0010, 0013, 0029, 0057, 0083, 0092) while two (0042, 0090) already show the banner form to mirror. Twenty ADRs describe the reconciler subsystem with overrides among them (0055 amends 0083; 0092's adapters paragraph was overridden by ticket 82bb-439b-1c42-4abd; 0031 and 0107 carry landed transitions), so a reader cannot find the current decision without reading all twenty. Nine ADRs embed operator procedures that `infra/runbooks/` already holds in fuller form, and four docs teach removed or renamed surfaces (`edit_ticket(tags=…)`, `[operator-attested]`, moved module paths). The operator approved the hygiene pass (2026-09-06); two items in the brief were rejected by the research and are recorded as decisions: `docs/code-review-fp-ledger.md` is KEPT (it is the undated process contract that `src/rebar/llm/code_review/fp_ledger.py:5` names), and ADR 0029 is NOT superseded (ADRs 0103 and 0107 consume its arbitration unchanged), so it gets a "context landed" banner. The evidence-record targets, exact banner texts, the 0119 section outline, and the per-ADR runbook moves are fixed on origin/main 083620b08116 in this epic's first comment. ADR number 0119 is claimed by this epic for the consolidated reconciler record; the CLI epic holds 0117 and the MCP epic 0118.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] The five evidence files are posted verbatim as comments on their originating tickets and deleted with the two stubs; the phantom design-doc citations owned here are rewritten; the docs index gate is green. Checked by the relocation story's `diff` against each posted comment and `python scripts/check_docs_index.py --check`.
- [ ] The six ADRs carry the exact banner or status text, and 0092 carries its amendment section; the ADR numbering and index gates are green. Checked by the banner story's `sed`/`grep` assertions.
- [ ] ADR 0119 exists with one section per surviving reconciler decision (20 `from ADR 00xx` headings, at least three "supersedes" notes), and the 20 originals are marked Archived with bodies untouched. Checked by the consolidation story's grep counts and the two test-pinned ADR bodies staying green.
- [ ] Each of the nine runbook-shaped ADRs points at a runbook section that now holds its procedure, including two new runbooks. Checked by the runbook story's `grep -c 'infra/runbooks/'` per ADR and the link resolver.
- [ ] `docs/ticket-model.md`, `docs/plan-review-gate.md`, `docs/migrations.md`, and the `composer_edit.py` comment describe the live surfaces. Checked by the drift story's greps.
- [ ] `make verify` exits 0 after each story.

## Child decomposition
- S1 evidence records to tickets, delete the stubs, fix phantom citations: criterion 1; depends on the eval-harness epic's relocation of `docs/experiments/`.
- S2 ADR banners and the 0092 amendment: criterion 2; independent.
- S3 consolidate the reconciler ADRs into ADR 0119: criterion 3; depends on S2, on the CLI and MCP ADR stories (0117, 0118 must exist), and on the reconciler epic's package move so 0119 cites final paths.
- S4 procedures to runbooks: criterion 4; depends on S3.
- S5 doc drift fixes: criterion 5; independent.
